episodes.title: Murthehelp
episodes.summary: Jian, who is helplessly attacked in her own home, dodges the flying bullets.

episodes.title: Jeong Jinman, Jeong Jinman, Jeong Jinman
episodes.summary: Jinman receives an unexpected call. Jian, who is alone at home, is pursued by unidentified men.

episodes.title: The Strong Don't Howl
episodes.summary: Jian finds herself in danger as she searches for a rescue phone in the mountains to save Jinman.

episodes.title: The Shopping Mall
episodes.summary: Jian and Jeongmin flee from the killers and meet Brother in the underground shopping mall.

episodes.title: Babylon
episodes.summary: Jian gets angry as she watches Jinman on the screen, and Jeongmin points a gun at Jian's head.

episodes.title: Jeong Jinman
episodes.summary: Jinman, who was once a mercenary of a large company, Babylon, suffers from the truth he learns.

episodes.title: Trap
episodes.summary: Bale, who was presumed to be dead, begins his revenge, and Jinman fights back to protect Jian.

episodes.title: Listen Up, Jian
episodes.summary: Killers close in on Jinman's house. Jian prepares for the final duel on her own.

episodes.title: Jinman, That Same Day
episodes.summary: Jinman returns and the truth behind the day he faked his death begins to emerge.

episodes.title: Recluse
episodes.summary: A new adversary appears, disrupting the balance and challenging The Murthehelp team.

episodes.title: Past Is Past, Present Is Present
episodes.summary: Jinman's past and the history Jian tried to erase resurface, placing them both in danger.

episodes.title: Raid
episodes.summary: Jian faces a harsh reality, while Jinman confronts a long-standing enemy.

episodes.title: Negotiation
episodes.summary: Accepting her fate, Jian takes a unique stand against Babylon.

episodes.title: The Trojan Horse
episodes.summary: An unexpected crisis puts the murthehelp team at risk, forcing Jinman to try and resolve it.

episodes.title: The Enemy of My Enemy
episodes.summary: Facing their most difficult challenge yet, Jian and the team struggle to hold on.

episodes.title: Listen Up, Jinman
episodes.summary: Murthehelp and Babylon face off in a final battle.
